parameters.query:
with conta_resolvida as (
  select a.id::text as account_id, a.bank, a.name as account_name
  from public.accounts a
  where (a.owner_id = $9::uuid or a.user_id = $11::uuid)
    and nullif($12, '') is not null
    and (
      unaccent($12) ilike '%' || unaccent(a.bank) || '%'
      or unaccent($12) ilike '%' || unaccent(a.name) || '%'
      or (a.type = 'credito' and $12 ilike '%cart%')
      or (a.type in ('conta_corrente','debito') and (
        unaccent($12) ilike '%deb%' or unaccent($12) ilike '%pix%' or unaccent($12) ilike '%conta%'
      ))
    )
  order by
    case when (unaccent($12) ilike '%' || unaccent(a.bank) || '%' or unaccent($12) ilike '%' || unaccent(a.name) || '%') then 0 else 1 end,
    case
      when a.type = 'credito' and $12 ilike '%cart%' then 0
      when a.type in ('conta_corrente','debito') and (
        unaccent($12) ilike '%deb%' or unaccent($12) ilike '%pix%' or unaccent($12) ilike '%conta%'
      ) then 0
      else 1
    end
  limit 1
),
subcategoria_resolvida as (
  select cs.id, cs.name
  from public.custom_subcategories cs
  where cs.user_id = $11::uuid
    and cs.category_id = $3
    and nullif(trim($4), '') is not null
    and lower(unaccent(trim(cs.name))) = lower(unaccent(trim($4)))
  limit 1
),
subcategorias_do_cliente as (
  select json_agg(cs.name order by cs.name) as nomes
  from public.custom_subcategories cs
  where cs.user_id = $11::uuid
    and cs.category_id = $3
    and nullif(trim($4), '') is not null
),
novo_lancamento as (
  insert into public.transactions
    (description, date, category_id, subcategory_id, type, value, account_id, owner_id, payment_date, pending_review, created_at, user_id, source)
  values
    (
      $1,
      $2::date,
      $3,
      (select id::text from subcategoria_resolvida),
      $5,
      $6::numeric,
      coalesce(nullif($7, ''), (select account_id from conta_resolvida), 'dinheiro'),
      $9::uuid,
      nullif($8, '')::date,
      false,
      nullif($10, '')::timestamptz,
      $11::uuid,
      'whatsapp_ia'
    )
  returning id, description, date, category_id, subcategory_id, value, type, owner_id, account_id
),
conta as (
  select op.user_id
  from public.owner_profiles op
  where op.id = (select owner_id from novo_lancamento)
),
periodo as (
  select
    date_trunc('month', (select date from novo_lancamento))::date as mes_inicio,
    (date_trunc('month', (select date from novo_lancamento)) + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date as mes_fim
),
-- "Ambos" nao e mais proprietario: e uma marcacao por categoria/ano feita no app.
-- Se a categoria estiver marcada como conjunta, o orcamento e o realizado passam a
-- considerar todos os proprietarios da conta, nao so o do lancamento.
eh_conjunta as (
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.budget_joint_categories bjc
    where bjc.user_id = (select user_id from conta)
      and bjc.category_id = (select category_id from novo_lancamento)
      and bjc.year between extract(year from (select mes_inicio from periodo))::int
                       and extract(year from (select mes_fim from periodo))::int
  ) as conjunta
),
owners_escopo as (
  select op.id, op.name, op.is_joint
  from public.owner_profiles op
  where op.user_id = (select user_id from conta)
    and (
      (select conjunta from eh_conjunta)
      or op.id = (select owner_id from novo_lancamento)
    )
),
planejado_por_owner as (
  select oe.id, oe.name, oe.is_joint,
         coalesce(sum(b.planned_value), 0) as planejado
  from owners_escopo oe
  left join public.budgets b
    on b.owner_id = oe.id
   and b.category_id = (select category_id from novo_lancamento)
   and b.year = extract(year from (select mes_inicio from periodo))::int
   and b.month = extract(month from (select mes_inicio from periodo))::int - 1
  group by oe.id, oe.name, oe.is_joint
),
planejado as (
  select coalesce(sum(planejado), 0) as planejado from planejado_por_owner
),
realizado as (
  -- Postgres: um CTE nao enxerga as linhas inseridas por outro CTE no mesmo statement
  -- (todos usam o mesmo snapshot). Por isso somamos os OUTROS lancamentos e adicionamos
  -- o valor recem-lancado separadamente.
  select coalesce(sum(abs(t.value)), 0) + abs((select value from novo_lancamento)) as realizado
  from public.transactions t, periodo p
  where t.owner_id in (select id from owners_escopo)
    and t.category_id = (select category_id from novo_lancamento)
    and t.type = (select type from novo_lancamento)
    and t.deleted = false
    and t.id <> (select id from novo_lancamento)
    and t.date >= p.mes_inicio and t.date <= p.mes_fim
),
conta_final as (
  select a.bank, a.name as account_name
  from public.accounts a
  where a.id::text = (select account_id from novo_lancamento)
)
select
  (select id from novo_lancamento) as lancamento_id,
  (select description from novo_lancamento) as description,
  (select date from novo_lancamento) as date,
  (select category_id from novo_lancamento) as category_id,
  (select value from novo_lancamento) as value,
  (select type from novo_lancamento) as type,
  (select account_id from novo_lancamento) as account_id,
  (select bank from conta_final) as bank,
  (select account_name from conta_final) as account_name,
  (select planejado from planejado) as planejado,
  (select realizado from realizado) as realizado,
  (select conjunta from eh_conjunta) as categoria_conjunta,
  (select json_agg(json_build_object('nome', name, 'planejado', planejado) order by is_joint, name)
     from planejado_por_owner
    where planejado > 0 or is_joint = false) as planejado_por_titular,
  (select mes_inicio from periodo) as mes_inicio,
  (select mes_fim from periodo) as mes_fim,
  (select name from subcategoria_resolvida) as subcategoria_nome,
  (case when nullif(trim($4), '') is not null and (select id from subcategoria_resolvida) is null then true else false end) as subcategoria_nao_encontrada,
  (select nomes from subcategorias_do_cliente) as subcategorias_existentes;

    and t.type = (select type from primeira_parcela)

  (select id from primeira_parcela) as lancamento_id,

  (select account_id from primeira_parcela) as account_id,

  (select max(date) from novos_lancamentos) as data_ultima_parcela,
  (select count(*) from novos_lancamentos) as qtd_parcelas_criadas,

novos_lancamentos as (
  insert into public.transactions
    (description, date, category_id, subcategory_id, type, value, account_id, owner_id, payment_date,
     pending_review, created_at, user_id, source,
     installment_group_id, installment_number, total_installments, installment_total_assumed, confirmed)
  select
    $1 || ' (' || pg.installment_number || '/' || $13 || ')',
    pg.data_parcela,
    $3,
    (select id::text from subcategoria_resolvida),
    $5,
    $6::numeric,
    coalesce(nullif($7, ''), (select account_id from conta_resolvida), 'dinheiro'),
    $9::uuid,
    case when pg.data_parcela <= current_date then nullif($8, '')::date else null end,
    false,
    nullif($10, '')::timestamptz,
    $11::uuid,
    'whatsapp_ia',
    (select installment_group_id from grupo),
    pg.installment_number,
    $13::int,
    false,
    pg.data_parcela <= current_date
  from parcelas_geradas pg
  returning id, description, date, category_id, value, type, owner_id, account_id, installment_number, total_installments
),
primeira_parcela as (
  select * from novos_lancamentos where installment_number = 1
),
conta as (
  select op.user_id from public.owner_profiles op where op.id = (select owner_id from primeira_parcela)
),
periodo as (
  select
    date_trunc('month', (select date from primeira_parcela))::date as mes_inicio,
    (date_trunc('month', (select date from primeira_parcela)) + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date as mes_fim
),
eh_conjunta as (
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.budget_joint_categories bjc
    where bjc.user_id = (select user_id from conta)
      and bjc.category_id = (select category_id from primeira_parcela)
      and bjc.year between extract(year from (select mes_inicio from periodo))::int
                       and extract(year from (select mes_fim from periodo))::int
  ) as conjunta
),
owners_escopo as (
  select op.id, op.name, op.is_joint
  from public.owner_profiles op
  where op.user_id = (select user_id from conta)
    and ((select conjunta from eh_conjunta) or op.id = (select owner_id from primeira_parcela))
),
planejado_por_owner as (
  select oe.id, oe.name, oe.is_joint, coalesce(sum(b.planned_value), 0) as planejado
  from owners_escopo oe
  left join public.budgets b
    on b.owner_id = oe.id
   and b.category_id = (select category_id from primeira_parcela)
   and b.year = extract(year from (select mes_inicio from periodo))::int
   and b.month = extract(month from (select mes_inicio from periodo))::int - 1
  group by oe.id, oe.name, oe.is_joint
),
planejado as (
  select coalesce(sum(planejado), 0) as planejado from planejado_por_owner
),
realizado as (
  select coalesce(sum(abs(t.value)), 0) + abs((select value from primeira_parcela)) as realizado
  from public.transactions t, periodo p
  where t.owner_id in (select id from owners_escopo)
    and t.category_id = (select category_id from primeira_parcela)
    and t.type = (select type from primeira_parcela)
    and t.deleted = false
    and t.id <> (select id from primeira_parcela)
    and t.date >= p.mes_inicio and t.date <= p.mes_fim
),
conta_final as (
  select a.bank, a.name as account_name
  from public.accounts a
  where a.id::text = (select account_id from primeira_parcela)
)
select
  (select id from primeira_parcela) as lancamento_id,
  (select description from primeira_parcela) as description,
  (select date from primeira_parcela) as date,
  (select category_id from primeira_parcela) as category_id,
  (select value from primeira_parcela) as value,
  (select type from primeira_parcela) as type,
  (select account_id from primeira_parcela) as account_id,
  (select bank from conta_final) as bank,
  (select account_name from conta_final) as account_name,
  (select planejado from planejado) as planejado,
  (select realizado from realizado) as realizado,
  (select conjunta from eh_conjunta) as categoria_conjunta,
  (select json_agg(json_build_object('nome', name, 'planejado', planejado) order by is_joint, name)
     from planejado_por_owner
    where planejado > 0 or is_joint = false) as planejado_por_titular,
  (select mes_inicio from periodo) as mes_inicio,
  (select mes_fim from periodo) as mes_fim,
  $13::int as total_parcelas,
  (select min(date) from novos_lancamentos) as data_primeira_parcela,
  (select max(date) from novos_lancamentos) as data_ultima_parcela,
  (select count(*) from novos_lancamentos) as qtd_parcelas_criadas,
  (select installment_group_id from grupo) as installment_group_id,
  (select name from subcategoria_resolvida) as subcategoria_nome,
  (case when nullif(trim($4), '') is not null and (select id from subcategoria_resolvida) is null then true else false end) as subcategoria_nao_encontrada,
  (select nomes from subcategorias_do_cliente) as subcategorias_existentes;
